theorem norm_S_eta2_le_trivial {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (α : ℝ) : ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ 17 * z := by
  unfold S
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.floor_lt hz.le] at hn
    rw [eta2_eq_zero, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    rintro ⟨-, h1⟩
    rw [div_lt_one hz] at h1
    linarith
  rw [tsum_eq_sum hs]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ‖((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α)‖ ≤ 3 * Λ n := by
    intro n _
    rw [norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _))]
    nlinarith [eta2_le (n / z), @ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg n]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hpsi : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1), Λ n = Chebyshev.psi z := by
    have e : Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
      ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hpsi]
  have h4 : Real.log 4 < 1.3863 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; push_cast; linarith
  have := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hz.le
  nlinarith

theorem eta2_nonneg (r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ eta2 r := by
  unfold eta2; split_ifs <;> positivity

/-- `|η₂|₁ = 1`. -/
theorem integral_abs_eta2 : ∫ t, |eta2 t| = 1 := by
  have habs : (fun t => |eta2 t|) = (Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) 1).indicator eta2 := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) 1
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg t)]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, eta2_eq_zero (fun h => ht (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self h)),
        abs_zero]
  rw [habs, integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num)]
  have hii : ∀ a b, 1 / 4 ≤ a → b ≤ 1 → a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable eta2 volume a b := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    refine (continuousOn_eta2.mono ?_).intervalIntegrable
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]; exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc ha hb
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (b := 1 / 2)
    (hii _ _ le_rfl (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) (hii _ _ (by norm_num) le_rfl (by norm_num))]
  have hL : ∫ t in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..1 / 2, eta2 t = 2 * Real.log 2 - 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun t => 4 * Real.log (4 * t)) fun t ht => by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at ht; exact eta2_eq_left ht.1 ht.2]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun t => Real.log t) (by norm_num : (4:ℝ) ≠ 0),
      integral_log]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hR : ∫ t in (1 / 2 : ℝ)..1, eta2 t = 2 - 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun t => -4 * Real.log t) fun t ht => by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at ht; exact eta2_eq_right ht.1 ht.2]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      integral_log]
    simp only [Real.log_one, one_div, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  rw [hL, hR]; ring

    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hZ0 hZpos]

/-- `G(t) ≥ log t + 1.064` for `t ≥ 20000`, from (12.12). -/
theorem G_ge_log {t : ℝ} (ht : 20000 ≤ t) : Real.log t + 1.064 ≤ Gq 1 t := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, -, hram⟩ := ramare_Gq
  have h := (abs_le.1 (hram 1 le_rfl t (by linarith))).1
  have hS : Sq 1 = 0 := by simp [Sq]
  have hf : f1q 1 = 1 := by simp [f1q]
  rw [hS, hf] at h
  simp only [Nat.totient_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one, one_mul, mul_one, add_zero] at h
  have := rpow_neg_third_le ht
  nlinarith

annotation.note: [L] bounds the same tail only for $j=2$, $m=1$, and by a different argument: a computed finite segment plus the $1/m^2$ tail, never forming $C/A^{j-1}$ or the rearrangement with $(A^{j-1}-1)/A^{j-1}$.

proof_context.conclusion: For $j=2$, $m=1$, bounds the tail $\sum_{m\ge N}\mu^2(m)/m^2$ by the finite sum $\sum_{N\le m<N+L}c(m)/m^2$ plus $1/(N+L-1)$ (`tsum_inv_sq_tail`), with no use of $C=\zeta(2)/\zeta(4)$.

snippet.text:
/-- The tail `∑_{m ≥ N} [m sq-free]/m² ≤ ∑_{N ≤ m < N + L} c(m)/m² + 1/(N + L − 1)`. -/
theorem tail_le (N L : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    ∑' k, sqInd (k + N) / ((k + N : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range L, ((cq (k + N) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((k + N : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1 / (((L + N : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) := by
  set g : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => sqInd (k + N) / ((k + N : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 with hg
  have hgs : Summable g := summable_sqInd_div N
  have hsplit := hgs.sum_add_tsum_nat_add L
  have hfin : ∑ k ∈ range L, g k ≤ ∑ k ∈ range L, ((cq (k + N) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((k + N : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    sum_le_sum fun k _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sqInd_le_cq _) (by positivity)
  have hs : Summable (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k + (L + N) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff (L + N)).2 (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.2 one_lt_two)
  have htail : ∑' k, g (k + L) ≤ ∑' k, 1 / ((k + (L + N) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => ?_) ((summable_nat_add_iff L).2 hgs) hs
    simp only [hg]
    rw [show k + L + N = k + (L + N) by omega]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sqInd_le_one _) (by positivity)
  have h2 := tsum_inv_sq_tail (M := L + N) (by omega)
  rw [← hsplit]
  linarith

snippet.text:
/-- **Ternary Goldbach for odd `5 < n ≤ 10²⁷`**. -/
theorem ternaryGoldbachUpTo_1e27 : TernaryGoldbachUpTo (10 ^ 27) := by
  intro n hn h5 hle
  have hBG := binary_goldbach_input
  by_cases hsmall : n ≤ 4 * 10 ^ 18 + 3
  · -- `n = 3 + (n − 3)`
    have hev : Even (n - 3) := Nat.Odd.sub_odd hn (by decide)
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq⟩ := hBG (n - 3) hev (by obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hn; omega) (by omega)
    exact ⟨3, p, q, Nat.prime_three, hp, hq, by omega⟩
  · -- a prime `p ∈ [n − 4·10¹⁸, n − 4]` from rung `i` of the ladder
    push Not at hsmall
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 := by omega
    have hi2 : (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 ≤ 254638308 := by omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := Ladder.ladder_prime hi1 hi2
    have hpb : p ≤ n - 4 := by omega
    have hpa : n - 4 * 10 ^ 18 ≤ p := by omega
    have hp2' : p ≠ 2 := by omega
    have hpo : Odd p := hp.odd_of_ne_two hp2'
    have hev : Even (n - p) := Nat.Odd.sub_odd hn hpo
    obtain ⟨q, r, hq, hr, hqr⟩ := hBG (n - p) hev (by omega) (by omega)
    exact ⟨p, q, r, hp, hq, hr, by omega⟩

snippet.text:
theorem mellin_comp_mul_left (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    mellin (fun t => f (a * t)) s = (a : ℂ) ^ (-s) • mellin f s := by
  simp_rw [mellin]
  have : EqOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f (a * t))
      (fun t : ℝ => (a : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) • (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f u) (a * t))
        (Ioi 0) := fun t ht ↦ by
    dsimp only
    rw [ofReal_mul, mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg ha.le (le_of_lt ht), ← mul_smul,
      (by ring : 1 - s = -(s - 1)), cpow_neg, inv_mul_cancel_left₀]
    rw [Ne, cpow_eq_zero_iff, ofReal_eq_zero, not_and_or]
    exact Or.inl ha.ne'
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi this, integral_smul,
    integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun u ↦ (u : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f u) _ ha,
    mul_zero, ← Complex.coe_smul, ← mul_smul, sub_eq_add_neg,
    cpow_add _ _ (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne'), cpow_one, ofReal_inv,
    mul_assoc, mul_comm, inv_mul_cancel_right₀ (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne')]

theorem arc_chars {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hqt : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 300000)

theorem hfun_antitone {z₁ z₂ : ℝ} (h9 : rexp 9 ≤ z₁) (h12 : z₁ ≤ z₂) : hfun z₂ ≤ hfun z₁ := by
  have hz₁ : 0 < z₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 9) h9
  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12
  have hrp : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → ∀ p : ℝ, z ^ p = rexp (p * Real.log z) := fun z hz p => by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]
      have : 0 ≤ s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hB := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s) (Q' := fun _ => 1) (s₁ := 9)
    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])
  have m1 : Real.log z₁ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁, hs12⟩
  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩
  have h1 := hA m1 m2 hs12
  have h2 := hB m1 m2 hs12
  simp only at h1 h2
  unfold hfun
  rw [hrp z₁ hz₁, hrp z₂ hz₂, hrp z₁ hz₁ (-1 / 3), hrp z₂ hz₂ (-1 / 3)]
  have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 6 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 6) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  have e2 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 3 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 3) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  rw [e1, e1, e2, e2]
  nlinarith

`G(w) z ≥ 0.276 z^{5/6} (log z)^{3/2} + 1234 z^{2/3} log z`. Then
`|S_{η_*}(α, x)| ≤ y (∫_{w₀}^{w₁} Gφ + 17 (∫_0^{w₀} φ + ∫_{w₁}^∞ φ))`. -/
theorem prop_11_2_3' {α x n w₀ w₁ : ℝ} {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n (x / κ)) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hw₀1 : w₀ ≤ 1) (hw₁ : 1 ≤ w₁)
    (hy : 2.16e20 ≤ w₀ * (x / κ)) (hn : 670 ≤ w₀ * n)

    (hG2 : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, 0.276 * (w * (x / κ)) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * (x / κ)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +

    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +

proof.summary: The Rosser-Schoenfeld product bound is stated for primes x≥5, and `div_totient_lt` applies it at x=p_k for at least four primes and compares with log r.

provenance.method: carried from book Lemma C.2.2 step 1, the same LaTeX (mapper (sonnet); verifier (sonnet))

annotation.note: Lean does not split on q>=27 or use monotonicity of Digamma in r; it applies Thm 15 at the k-th prime x with k=omega(q)>=4 and replaces q by the primorial via the exchange argument, then uses monotonicity of t -> G t + c/t.

proof_context.conclusion: RS62 Thm 15 in product form for primes x>=5: prod_{p<=x} p/(p-1) < e^gamma log theta(x) + 2.50637/log theta(x).

snippet.text:
theorem F_all {x : ℕ} (hx : x.Prime) (h5 : 5 ≤ x) :
    ∏ p ∈ (Icc 1 x).filter Nat.Prime, ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1)) <
      Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (thetaN x) +
        2.50637 / Real.log (thetaN x) := by
  rcases le_or_gt x (10 ^ 5) with h | h
  · exact MertProd.mertens_product_kernel x hx h5 h
  rcases lt_or_ge x (10 ^ 12) with h' | h'
  · exact F_mid (by omega) h'
  · exact F_large h'

proof_context.conclusion: For k>=4 distinct primes, sets x=p_k and applies F_all at x, then compares with log r.

theorem hfun_antitone {z₁ z₂ : ℝ} (h9 : rexp 9 ≤ z₁) (h12 : z₁ ≤ z₂) : hfun z₂ ≤ hfun z₁ := by
  have hz₁ : 0 < z₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 9) h9
  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12
  have hrp : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → ∀ p : ℝ, z ^ p = rexp (p * Real.log z) := fun z hz p => by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]
      have : 0 ≤ s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hB := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s) (Q' := fun _ => 1) (s₁ := 9)
    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])
  have m1 : Real.log z₁ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁, hs12⟩
  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩
  have h1 := hA m1 m2 hs12
  have h2 := hB m1 m2 hs12
  simp only at h1 h2
  unfold hfun
  rw [hrp z₁ hz₁, hrp z₂ hz₂, hrp z₁ hz₁ (-1 / 3), hrp z₂ hz₂ (-1 / 3)]
  have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 6 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 6) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  have e2 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 3 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 3) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  rw [e1, e1, e2, e2]
  nlinarith

/-- If `Q' ≤ p Q` on `[s₁, s₂]`, then `s ↦ Q(s) e^{-ps}` is antitone there. -/
theorem antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg {Q Q' : ℝ → ℝ} {s₁ s₂ p : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt Q (Q' s) s) (hle : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, Q' s ≤ p * Q s) :
    AntitoneOn (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s)) (Icc s₁ s₂) := by
  have hD : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s))
      (Q' s * rexp (-p * s) + Q s * (rexp (-p * s) * (-p))) s := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -p * s) (-p) s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-p)
    exact (hd s hs).mul h1.exp
  refine antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc _ _)
    (fun s hs => (hD s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hD s (interior_subset hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) fun s hs => ?_
  rw [(hD s (interior_subset hs)).deriv]
  have := hle s (interior_subset hs)
  have he := (Real.exp_pos (-p * s)).le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 this) he]

        (13 / 4 * (Real.log 2 + s) + 7.82) + Fs s * (13 / 4 * 1) + 13.66 * 1)
    (fun s hs => ?_) (fun s hs => ?_)

    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.log 2 + s) 1 s := (hasDerivAt_id s).const_add _
    unfold QC

annotation.note: Lean tests monotonicity by Q'/Q <= p (log-derivative) on the full main term in s = log r, not on the log of expression (horko) in r; range s >= 6 (r >= 403, used with r >= 670).

/-- If `Q' ≤ p Q` on `[s₁, s₂]`, then `s ↦ Q(s) e^{-ps}` is antitone there. -/
theorem antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg {Q Q' : ℝ → ℝ} {s₁ s₂ p : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt Q (Q' s) s) (hle : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, Q' s ≤ p * Q s) :
    AntitoneOn (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s)) (Icc s₁ s₂) := by
  have hD : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s))
      (Q' s * rexp (-p * s) + Q s * (rexp (-p * s) * (-p))) s := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -p * s) (-p) s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-p)
    exact (hd s hs).mul h1.exp
  refine antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc _ _)
    (fun s hs => (hD s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hD s (interior_subset hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) fun s hs => ?_
  rw [(hD s (interior_subset hs)).deriv]
  have := hle s (interior_subset hs)
  have he := (Real.exp_pos (-p * s)).le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 this) he]

/-- [H, (11.9)]: `S_{η_*}(α, x) = ∫₀^∞ S_{η₂}(α, w y) φ(w) dw/w` with `y = x/κ`. -/
theorem S_etaStar_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    S etaStar x α = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), S eta2 (w * (x / κ)) α * ((phi w / w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  set F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n w =>
    ((Λ n * eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) with hF
  have hphiw : ∀ w, 0 < w → phi w / w = w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2) := by
    intro w hw
    unfold phi
    field_simp
  -- `η_*(n/x)` as a `w`-integral
  have hstar : ∀ n : ℕ, etaStar (n / x) = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
      unfold etaStar mellinConv
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_div]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w _ => ?_
      have h1 : phi 0 = 0 := by simp [phi]
      have h2 : eta2 0 = 0 := by simp [eta2]
      simp [h1, h2]
    · unfold etaStar
      rw [mellinConv_eq_swap _ _ (by positivity)]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      congr 2
      rw [hy_def]
      field_simp
  have hstar0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ etaStar (n / x) := by
    intro n
    rw [hstar n]
    refine setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    exact mul_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _) (div_nonneg this hw.le)
  -- measurability and domination
  have hmeas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable fun w : ℝ => eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    have hphi : Continuous phi := by unfold phi; fun_prop
    exact (continuous_eta2.measurable.comp (measurable_const.div (measurable_id.mul_const y))).mul
      (hphi.measurable.div measurable_id)
  have hgauss : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num)).integrableOn
  have hint_real : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w)) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro n
    refine Integrable.mono' (hgauss.const_mul 3) (hmeas n).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_)
    rw [hphiw w hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (eta2_le _) (by positivity)
  have hFint : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    intro n
    have : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ((Λ n * (eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := ((hint_real n).const_mul (Λ n)).ofReal
    refine (this.mul_const (TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α))).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ?_)
    simp only [F, mul_assoc]
  have hFn : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), F n w =
      ((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) := by
    intro n
    simp only [F]
    rw [integral_mul_const, integral_complex_ofReal, hstar n, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 3
    funext w
    ring
  have hFnorm : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖F n w‖ = ‖((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
    intro n
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (hstar0 n)), hstar n,
      ← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    simp only [F, norm_mul, norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),
      abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg this hw.le)]
    ring
  have hsum : Summable fun n => ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖F n w‖ := by
    simp only [hFnorm]
    exact summable_etaStar hx

theorem R_le_R {z z' t t' : ℝ} (ht' : 1 ≤ 4 * t') (htt : t' ≤ t)
    (hb : 1 < 9 * z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / (2.004 * t))

/-- **[H, Prop. 11.2.3], corrected** (first case, `q` small).  Let `y = x/κ` and

`r = max(1, |δ|/8) q`.  Let `0 < w₀ ≤ 1 ≤ w₁` with `w₀ y ≥ 2.16·10²⁰`, `q ≤ (w₀y)^{1/3}/6`,
`w₀ r ≥ 670`, and `|δ/y| ≤ 1/(q Q_{w₁y})`.  If `G(w) ≥ g_{wy}(min(1, w) r)` on `[w₀, w₁]` with
`Gφ` integrable there, then
`|S_{η_*}(α, x)| ≤ y (∫_{w₀}^{w₁} G φ + 17 (∫_0^{w₀} φ + ∫_{w₁}^∞ φ))`. -/
theorem prop_11_2_3 {α x δ w₀ w₁ : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h : Approx2 α (x / κ) δ a q (3 / 4 * (x / κ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)))
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hw₀1 : w₀ ≤ 1) (hw₁ : 1 ≤ w₁) (hy : 2.16e20 ≤ w₀ * (x / κ))
    (hq : (q : ℝ) ≤ (w₀ * (x / κ)) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6)
    (hr : 670 ≤ w₀ * (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q))
    (hδ₁ : |δ / (x / κ)| ≤ 1 / (q * (3 / 4 * (w₁ * (x / κ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))))
    (hG : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, gx (w * (x / κ)) (min 1 w * (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q)) ≤ G w)
    (hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Icc w₀ w₁)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +
      17 * ((∫ w in Ioo 0 w₀, phi w) + ∫ w in Ioi w₁, phi w)) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  set r := max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q with hr_def
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast h.1
  -- the majorant
  set B : ℝ → ℝ := fun w =>
    (Ioo 0 w₀).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) w +
      (Icc w₀ w₁).indicator (fun w => y * (G w * phi w)) w +
      (Ioi w₁).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) w with hB
  have hφi : IntegrableOn (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) univ :=
    (integrable_phi.const_mul (17 * y)).integrableOn
  have hBi : Integrable B (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    refine Integrable.add (Integrable.add ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hφi.mono_set (subset_univ _)) measurableSet_Ioo).restrict
    · exact (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hGi.const_mul y) measurableSet_Icc).restrict
    · exact (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hφi.mono_set (subset_univ _)) measurableSet_Ioi).restrict

    intro w (hw : 0 < w)
    have hφw : 0 ≤ phi w / w := div_nonneg (phi_nonneg w) hw.le

    rcases lt_or_ge w w₀ with h1 | h1
    · have : B w = 17 * y * phi w := by
        simp only [hB, indicator, mem_Ioo, mem_Icc, mem_Ioi, hw, h1, true_and, ite_true]

    · have hBw : B w = y * (G w * phi w) := by
        simp only [hB, indicator, mem_Ioo, mem_Icc, mem_Ioi]
        rw [ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith [h'.2]), ite_eq_left ⟨h1, h2⟩, ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith)]

      have hδz : |δ / y| ≤ 1 / (q * (3 / 4 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) :=

      have hup := r_le_cube_root hz h' hqz

proof_context.conclusion: Prop 12.1.2 for δ₀≥2: arc integral ≤ C Σ|aₙ|² given the G_q quotient bound.

snippet.text:
/-- **[H, Prop. 12.1.2]** (with `δ₀ ≥ 2`, see the module docstring).  Let `aₙ` be supported on
primes `> √x`, in `ℓ¹`; `δ₀ ≥ 2`, `Q₀ ≥ 1`, `δ₀Q₀² ≤ x/2`, `Q = √(x/2δ₀)`.  If
`G_q(2Q₀/sq) ≤ C G_q(2Q/sq)` for every even `q ≤ 2Q₀` and `1 ≤ s ≤ 2Q₀/q`, then
`∫_{𝔐_{δ₀,Q₀}} |S(α)|² dα ≤ C Σ |aₙ|²`. -/
theorem prop_12_1_2 {x δ₀ Q₀ C : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀) (hx : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀)) / (s * q))) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hsupp, hsum⟩ := ha
  set Q := √(x / (2 * δ₀)) with hQdef
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by nlinarith
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ₀ := by linarith
  have hQsq : Q ^ 2 = x / (2 * δ₀) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hδQ2 : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 = x / 2 := by rw [hQsq]; field_simp
  have hQ₀Q : Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hδx : δ₀ ≤ x / 2 := by
    have : δ₀ * 1 ≤ δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) hδ0.le
    linarith
  have hδQ : δ₀ * Q ≤ x := by
    have hsq : (δ₀ * Q) ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hQsq]
      rw [show δ₀ ^ 2 * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = δ₀ * x / 2 by field_simp]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_pos hδ0 hQ0]
  have h2Q : 2 * Q ≤ √x := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    rw [mul_pow, hQsq]
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = 2 * x / δ₀ by field_simp, div_le_iff₀ hδ0]
    nlinarith
  -- the common modulus
  set L := ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊2 * Q⌋₊, q with hL
  have hL0 : L ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun q hq => by
    have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1; omega
  have : NeZero L := ⟨hL0⟩
  have hqL : ∀ R, R ≤ Q → ∀ q ∈ Qset R, q ∣ L := by
    intro R hR q hq
    apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
    obtain ⟨hq1, -⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨h1, h2.trans (Nat.floor_le_floor (by linarith))⟩
  have hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hp, hnx⟩ := hsupp n hn
    refine Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun q hq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq
    refine (Nat.coprime_or_dvd_of_prime hp q).resolve_right fun hdvd => ?_
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    have : (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hq2) (Nat.floor_le (by positivity))
    have : (n : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hle
    linarith
  -- `C ≥ 0`
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have h := hC 2 (by norm_num) even_two (by push_cast; linarith) 1 le_rfl (by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; push_cast; linarith)
    have e1 : 2 * Q₀ / (1 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = Q₀ := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e1] at h
    have hG1 := one_le_Gq_two hQ₀
    have hGQ := Gq_nonneg 2 (2 * Q / (1 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    by_contra hneg; push Not at hneg
    nlinarith
  -- the chain
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun α => ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2
  have hg : Continuous g := (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_expTsum hsum).norm.pow 2
  have hper : Function.Periodic g 1 := fun α => by simp only [g, expTsum_periodic a α]
  have hg0 : ∀ α, 0 ≤ g α := fun α => by positivity
  have hδQ₀ : δ₀ * Q₀ ≤ x := by nlinarith
  calc ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ Qset Q₀, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q₀ x q b, g y :=
        integral_majorArcs_le hg hper hg0 hx0 (by positivity) hδQ₀
    _ = ∫ β, Farc a δ₀ Q₀ x β := sum_arcs_eq_integral_Farc hsum δ₀ Q₀ x
    _ ≤ ∫ β, C * Farc a δ₀ Q x β :=
        integral_mono (integrable_Farc hsum _ _ _) ((integrable_Farc hsum _ _ _).const_mul C)
          fun β => Farc_le hx0 hQ₀ hQ₀Q hC0 hC (hqL Q₀ hQ₀Q) (hqL Q le_rfl) hsum hcop
    _ = C * ∑ q ∈ Qset Q, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q x q b, g y := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, sum_arcs_eq_integral_Farc hsum δ₀ Q x]
    _ ≤ C * ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, g α :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_arcs_le_integral hg hper hg0 hx0 hδ0 hQ0 hδQ2.le hδQ) hC0
    _ = C * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.setIntegral_norm_sq_expTsum hsum]

proof_context.conclusion: Quotient bound G_q(2Q₀/sq) ≤ C·G_q(2Q/sq) with c₊=2 (Prop 12.2.4).

/-- **[H, Prop 12.2.4] with `c₊ = 2`** (for [H]'s `1.36`). -/
theorem prop_12_2_4 {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (_hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q₀) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsQ : s ≤ Q₀ / q) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 2) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsq : 0 < s * q := by positivity
  have hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hsq, one_mul]; rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hsQ; exact hsQ
  have hLQ : 0 < Real.log Q + cE := by
    have : 0 < Real.log Q := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    unfold cE; linarith
  have hG' := Gq_nonneg_q q (Q / (s * q))
  set R := Q₀ / (s * q) with hRdef
  rcases le_or_gt 22000000000 q with hbig | hsmall
  · -- large `q`: [H]'s argument, with `1.36`
    refine weaken_136 hG' hLQ ?_
    rcases le_or_gt (lamQ q) R with hL | hL
    · exact regionL hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR hL
    have hq' : (22000000000 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hbig
    have hlq : 3 ≤ Real.log q := by
      have := log_Q1_ge.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hq'); linarith
    exact regionS hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR (by norm_num) hlq (hcc_large hbig) (large_q_hS hbig hR hL)
  · -- `q < 2.2·10¹⁰`: the reduction to `Φ`
    refine checkC2_suffices hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR ?_
    set n := ⌊R⌋₊
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hR)
    rcases le_or_gt n 3 with hn3 | hn4
    · exact Phi2_small hq hsmall hn1 hn3
    · have h := Phi2_reduce hn1 (fun A hA => Phi2_base hA (by omega)) q hq hsmall
      exact (Phi2_anti q n (le_max_left _ _)).trans h

proof_context.conclusion: Lean proves the (12.42) half: integral of |S|^2 over majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x in (0,1] is at most (log 2Q₀+2)/(log 2Q+cE)·Σ|aₙ|², with δ₀≥2 and c₊=2.

snippet.text:
/-- **[H, Cor. 12.2.5, (12.42)]** (with `δ₀ ≥ 2`).  Let `Q₀ ≥ 10⁵`, `δ₀ ≥ 2`,
`(20000 Q₀)² ≤ x/2δ₀`, `Q = √(x/2δ₀)`, `2Q₀ ≤ (2Q)^{0.6}`.  Then
`∫_{𝔐_{δ₀,Q₀}} |S|² ≤ (log 2Q₀ + 2)/(log 2Q + c_E) Σ|aₙ|²`. -/
theorem cor_12_2_5 {x δ₀ Q₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀) (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hx : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀))
    (hρ : 2 * Q₀ ≤ (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) ^ (0.6 : ℝ)) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  set Q := √(x / (2 * δ₀)) with hQdef
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by positivity) hx
  have hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hx
  refine prop_12_1_2 ha hδ₀ (by linarith) ?_ fun q hq _ hq2 s hs hsq => ?_
  · have h1 : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by nlinarith) hx
    have h2 : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = x / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  · have h2Q₀ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Q₀ := by linarith
    have hlog : Real.log (2 * Q₀) ≤ 0.6 * Real.log (2 * Q) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log h2Q₀ hρ
      rwa [Real.log_rpow (by nlinarith)] at this
    exact prop_12_2_4 (by linarith) (by linarith) hlog hq hq2 hs hsq

proof_context.conclusion: Character expansion (Bombieri's identity `totient_mul_sum_units_lift`, the analogue of Ramare's Thm 2.1): $F_R(\beta)=\sum_{q}\sum^*_b|S(b/q+\beta)|^2$ equals $\sum_\Psi |S_{\Psi^{-1}}(\beta)|^2$ weighted by $(c/\varphi(c))\kappa_c G_{\tilde c}(m_R(\beta)/\tilde c)$.

theorem Farc_eq {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] {a : ℕ → ℂ} {δ₀ R x β : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hqL : ∀ q ∈ Qset R, q ∣ L) (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) :
    Farc a δ₀ R x β = ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L, ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 *
      (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ R x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor))) := by
  classical
  have hT : ∀ q ∈ Qset R, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum a ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L,
        (if Ψ.conductor ∣ q then TernaryGoldbach.wq q Ψ.conductor else 0) / q.totient *
          ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro q hq
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1).1
    have : NeZero q := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < q.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 (by omega)
    rw [sum_Bset_eq_units (fun t => ‖expTsum a t‖ ^ 2) β]
    have key := totient_mul_sum_units_lift (hqL q hq) ha hcop β
    simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div, ← key]
    field_simp
  unfold Farc
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => by rw [hT q hq], ← Finset.sum_filter, Qset_filter_eq hx,
    Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Ψ _ => ?_
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ Ψ.conductor := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (DirichletCharacter.conductor_ne_zero Ψ)
  rw [← weight_sum Ψ.conductor hc1, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  ring

proof_context.conclusion: Ramare's comparison: $F_{Q_0}(\beta)\le C\,F_Q(\beta)$ whenever $C$ bounds the ratios $G_q(2Q_0/sq)/G_q(2Q/sq)$; at $\beta=0$ this is $\sum_{\tilde q\le 2Q_0}\sum^*_b|S(b/q)|^2\le C\sum_{\tilde q\le 2Q}\sum^*_b|S(b/q)|^2$.

theorem Farc_le {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] {a : ℕ → ℂ} {δ₀ Q₀ Q x β C : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀)
    (hQQ : Q₀ ≤ Q) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * Q / (s * q)))
    (hqL₀ : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q₀, q ∣ L) (hqL : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q, q ∣ L) (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) :
    Farc a δ₀ Q₀ x β ≤ C * Farc a δ₀ Q x β := by
  rw [Farc_eq hx hqL₀ ha hcop, Farc_eq hx hqL ha hcop, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun Ψ _ => ?_
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ Ψ.conductor := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (DirichletCharacter.conductor_ne_zero Ψ)
  have hG := Gq_mR_le (δ₀ := δ₀) (x := x) (β := β) hx hQ₀ hQQ hC0 hC Ψ.conductor hc1
  have h1 : 0 ≤ ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (Ψ.conductor : ℝ) / Ψ.conductor.totient := by positivity
  have h3 := kap_nonneg Ψ.conductor
  calc ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 * (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ Q₀ x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor)))
      ≤ ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 * (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * (C * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ Q x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor)))) := by
        gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem log_prod_primeSetRq_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    Real.log (∏ p ∈ primeSetRq R q, p : ℕ) ≤ Real.log q + 1.039 * R := by
  have hpos : ∀ p ∈ primeSetRq R q, (0 : ℝ) < p := fun p hp => by
    exact_mod_cast (primeSetRq_prime p hp).pos
  rw [Nat.cast_prod, Real.log_prod (fun p hp => (hpos p hp).ne')]
  have hnn : ∀ p ∈ primeSetRq R q, 0 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) := fun p _ => Real.log_natCast_nonneg p
  have h1 : ∑ p ∈ primeSetRq R q, Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ) +
        ∑ p ∈ q.primeFactors, Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    unfold primeSetRq
    rw [← sum_union_inter]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sum_nonneg fun p _ => Real.log_natCast_nonneg p)
  have h2 : ∑ p ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 1.039 * R := by
    have h := (TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.thetaN_le_psiN ⌊R⌋₊).trans
      (TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.psiN_le ⌊R⌋₊)
    unfold TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.thetaN at h
    have hf : (⌊R⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ R := Nat.floor_le hR
    nlinarith
  have h3 : ∑ p ∈ q.primeFactors, Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q := by
    rw [← Real.log_prod (fun p hp => by
      have := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).pos; positivity)]
    apply Real.log_le_log (prod_pos fun p hp => by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).pos)
    have : ∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ q := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd q)
    have h2 : ((∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast this
    simpa [Nat.cast_prod] using h2
  linarith

/-- **`G_q(R) G_P(t) ≤ G_q(tR)`** if every prime `≤ R`, and every prime dividing `q`, divides `P`. -/
theorem Gq_mul_le {q P : ℕ} {R t : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hPR : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ R → p ∣ P) (hPq : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ q → p ∣ P) :
    Gq q R * Gq P t ≤ Gq q (t * R) := by
  set A := (Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q)
  set B := (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r P)
  set C := (Icc 1 ⌊t * R⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q)
  -- elements of `A` and `B` are coprime
  have hcop : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, Nat.Coprime a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at ha hb
    refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hpa hpb => ?_
    have hpa' : p ≤ a := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpa
    have hpR : (p : ℝ) ≤ R :=
      (by exact_mod_cast hpa'.trans ha.1.2 : (p : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le hR)
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime p b := (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (hPR p hp hpR) hb.2.symm)
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).1 h1 hpb
  rw [Gq_eq, Gq_eq, Gq_eq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun x hx => (gf_mul (hcop x.1 (mem_product.1 hx).1 x.2 (mem_product.1 hx).2)).symm]
  -- the map `(a, b) ↦ ab` is injective on `A × B`
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) (A ×ˢ B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    simp only [coe_product, Set.mem_prod, mem_coe] at hx hy
    simp only at hxy
    have hx1 : 0 < x.1 := by simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hx; omega
    have hy1 : 0 < y.1 := by simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hy; omega
    have d1 : x.1 ∣ y.1 := (hcop x.1 hx.1 y.2 hy.2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨x.2, by rw [← hxy]⟩
    have d2 : y.1 ∣ x.1 := (hcop y.1 hy.1 x.2 hx.2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨y.2, by rw [hxy]⟩
    have e1 : x.1 = y.1 := Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
    have e2 : x.2 = y.2 := by
      rw [e1] at hxy; exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hy1 hxy
    exact Prod.ext e1 e2
  rw [← sum_image (f := gf) hinj]
  refine sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun r _ _ => gf_nonneg r
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hm
  have ha := (mem_product.1 hab).1
  have hb := (mem_product.1 hab).2
  simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at ha hb
  simp only [C, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
  refine ⟨⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply Nat.le_floor
    push_cast
    have h1 : (a : ℝ) ≤ R := (by exact_mod_cast ha.1.2 : (a : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le hR)
    have h2 : (b : ℝ) ≤ t := (by exact_mod_cast hb.1.2 : (b : ℝ) ≤ ⌊t⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le ht)
    rw [mul_comm (a : ℝ)]
    exact mul_le_mul h2 h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ht
  · refine Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left.2 ⟨ha.2, ?_⟩
    refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hpb hpq => ?_
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime p b := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (hPq p hp hpq) hb.2.symm
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).1 h1 hpb

theorem G_le_mul_Gq {P : ℕ} (hP : Squarefree P) {t : ℝ} :
    Gq 1 t ≤ (P : ℝ) / Nat.totient P * Gq P t := by
  rw [← sum_divisors_gf hP, Gq_eq, Gq_eq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  set B := (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r P)
  -- restrict to squarefree `m`
  have hsq : ∑ m ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1), gf m =
      ∑ m ∈ ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree, gf m := by
    refine (sum_filter_of_ne fun m _ h => ?_).symm
    by_contra hs
    exact h (by simp [gf, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree hs])
  rw [hsq]
  set D := ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree
  -- `m ↦ (gcd(m, P), m / gcd(m, P))`
  set φm : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ := fun m => (Nat.gcd m P, m / Nat.gcd m P)
  have hmem : ∀ m ∈ D, φm m ∈ P.divisors ×ˢ B := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩, hsqf⟩ := hm
    have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd m P := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    refine mem_product.2 ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.2 ⟨Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P, hP.ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [B, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans h2⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)) hg
    · -- `m/gcd(m,P)` is coprime to `P` since `m` is squarefree
      refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hp1 hp2 => ?_
      have hpm : p ∣ m := hp1.trans (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P))
      have hpg : p ∣ Nat.gcd m P := Nat.dvd_gcd hpm hp2
      have : p * p ∣ m := by
        have e : m = Nat.gcd m P * (m / Nat.gcd m P) :=
          (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)).symm
        rw [e]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul hpg hp1
      exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.isUnit_iff.1 (hsqf p this))
  have hval : ∀ m ∈ D, gf m = gf (φm m).1 * gf (φm m).2 := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter] at hm
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.gcd m P) (m / Nat.gcd m P) := by
      have hB := (mem_product.1 (hmem m (by simp only [D, mem_filter]; exact hm))).2
      simp only [B, mem_filter] at hB
      exact (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P) hB.2.symm)
    rw [← gf_mul hcop, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φm (D : Set ℕ) := by
    intro x _ y _ hxy
    have e1 := congrArg (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => z.1 * z.2) hxy
    simp only [φm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ P)] at e1
    exact e1
  rw [sum_congr rfl hval, ← sum_image (f := fun x : ℕ × ℕ => gf x.1 * gf x.2) hinj]
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx; exact hmem m hm)
    fun x _ _ => mul_nonneg (gf_nonneg _) (gf_nonneg _)

    rw [kap, if_pos hce, one_mul, show qt c = c by unfold qt; rw [if_pos hce]]
    refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext r
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc, hqt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hr1, (le_floor_div_iff hr1 hc X).2 hrX⟩, hcop⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩
      have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 hc X).1 hrX
      refine ⟨⟨hr1, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, h, hcop⟩
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r hc
  · -- odd conductor: odd and even `r` contribute equally

    congr 1
    · -- odd `r`
      refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
      ext r
      simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right, Nat.coprime_two_right]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hodd⟩
        have hq : qt (c * r) = 2 * c * r := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_neg (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 (hco.mul hodd))]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hr1, (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩, hodd, hcop⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hodd, hcop⟩
        have hq : qt (c * r) = 2 * c * r := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_neg (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 (hco.mul hodd))]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX
        refine ⟨⟨⟨hr1, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, hcop⟩, hodd⟩

        simp_rw [moebius_sq_div_totient_two_mul]

        refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
        ext r
        simp only [B, mem_filter, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right]
        tauto
      rw [hB]
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun r => r / 2) (fun r' => 2 * r') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hev⟩ := hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hev
        have hk : k + k = 2 * k := by ring
        rw [hk] at hr1 hrX hcop ⊢
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]

        have hq : qt (c * (2 * k)) = 2 * c * k := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul k).mul_left c)]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hk1, (le_floor_div_iff hk1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩,
          Nat.Coprime.coprime_mul_left hcop⟩

        obtain ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩ := hr'

          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul r').mul_left c)]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX

      · intro r' _; omega
      · intro r hr

/-- **Gauss sum of an induced character**: for `f` periodic mod `N`, completely multiplicative,

            ((μ (2 * r') : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (2 * r').totient := by
        simp_rw [moebius_sq_div_totient_two_mul]
        rw [← sum_filter, filter_filter]
        refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
        ext r
        simp only [B, mem_filter, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right]
        tauto
      rw [hB]
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun r => r / 2) (fun r' => 2 * r') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hev⟩ := hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hev
        have hk : k + k = 2 * k := by ring
        rw [hk] at hr1 hrX hcop ⊢
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]
        have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * k)) = 2 * c * k := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul k).mul_left c)]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hk1, (le_floor_div_iff hk1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩,
          Nat.Coprime.coprime_mul_left hcop⟩
      · intro r' hr'
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr' ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩ := hr'
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * r')) = 2 * c * r' := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul r').mul_left c)]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX
        refine ⟨⟨⟨by omega, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, ?_⟩, even_two_mul r'⟩
        · push_cast; nlinarith [show (1:ℝ) ≤ c by exact_mod_cast hc, show (0:ℝ) ≤ r' by positivity]
        · exact Nat.Coprime.mul_left ((Nat.coprime_two_left).2 hco) hcop
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        omega
      · intro r' _; omega
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        rw [show k + k = 2 * k by ring, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]

proof.summary: `wrad_add_le` bounds the sum of two arc radii by the reciprocal of qq', and `arcs_unique` uses it to show the arcs are pairwise disjoint.

provenance.method: carried from book Proposition 12.1.1 step 17, the same LaTeX (mapper (sonnet); verifier (sonnet); judge (opus))

annotation.note: Lean proves disjointness for the (10.5) arcs of radius $\delta_0Q/(\tilde qx)$ over $\tilde q\le 2Q$ (odd q doubled, spacing constant D = 1 or 2), not the text's arcs of radius $1/2qQ$ over $q\le Q$.

proof_context.conclusion: From $\delta_0Q^2\le x/2$: $\delta_0Q/x\le 1/(2Q)$, so $w_q+w_{q'}\le D/(qq')$ ($D=2$ if both even, else 1) for $\tilde q,\tilde q'\le 2Q$.

snippet.text:
theorem wrad_add_le {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {q q' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hq' : 1 ≤ q') (hqQ : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) (hqQ' : (qt q' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) :
    wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' ≤ (if Even q ∧ Even q' then 2 else 1) / (q * q') := by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'
  -- `δ₀Q/x ≤ 1/(2Q)`
  have hk : δ₀ * Q / x ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → wrad δ₀ Q x p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < qt p := by have := two_le_qt hp; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < qt p)
    unfold wrad
    rw [show δ₀ * Q / (qt p * x) = δ₀ * Q / x / qt p by field_simp]
    calc δ₀ * Q / x / qt p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) / qt p := by gcongr
      _ = 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by field_simp
  refine (add_le_add (hw q hq) (hw q' hq')).trans ?_
  unfold qt at hqQ hqQ' ⊢
  by_cases he : Even q <;> by_cases he' : Even q' <;> simp only [he, he', if_true, if_false,
    and_self, and_true, and_false] at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;> push_cast at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;>
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] <;>
    nlinarith [mul_pos hqr hqr', mul_pos (mul_pos hqr hqr') hQ]

proof_context.conclusion: Arcs $J_{q,b}$ at level $Q$ (and their integer translates) are pairwise disjoint: overlapping arcs force $cq'=c'q$, hence $(q,b,k)=(q',b',k')$.

snippet.text:
/-- **The arcs at level `Q` are disjoint** (`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`): if `α − k ∈ J_{q,b}` and
`α − k' ∈ J_{q',b'}`, then `(q, b, k) = (q', b', k')`. -/
theorem arcs_unique {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {α : ℝ} {q b q' b' : ℕ} {k k' : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ Qset Q) (hb : b ∈ Bset q) (hq' : q' ∈ Qset Q)
    (hb' : b' ∈ Bset q') (h1 : α - k ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q b) (h2 : α - k' ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q' b') :
    q = q' ∧ b = b' ∧ k = k' := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hqQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
  obtain ⟨hq1', hqQ'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq'
  have hq1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1).1
  have hq1' := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1').1
  obtain ⟨hbq, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb
  obtain ⟨hbq', hbc'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb'
  have hbq := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq
  have hbq' := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq'
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1'
  set c : ℤ := b + k * q
  set c' : ℤ := b' + k' * q'
  have hc : (c : ℝ) / q = b / q + k := by simp only [c]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc' : (c' : ℝ) / q' = b' / q' + k' := by simp only [c']; push_cast; field_simp
  have hdist : |(c : ℝ) / q - c' / q'| < wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' := by
    obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    rw [hc, hc', abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hW := wrad_add_le hx hδ hQ hQx hq1 hq1' hqQ hqQ'
  -- `cq' = c'q`
  have hcross : c * q' = c' * q := by
    by_contra hne
    set N : ℤ := c * q' - c' * q
    have hN : N ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hexpr : (c : ℝ) / q - c' / q' = N / (q * q') := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; field_simp
    rw [hexpr, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < q * q')] at hdist
    have hD : (if Even q ∧ Even q' then (2 : ℝ) else 1) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
      split_ifs with hev
      · have hNe : Even N := by
          have e1 : Even (c * q') := ((Int.even_coe_nat q').2 hev.2).mul_left c
          have e2 : Even (c' * q) := ((Int.even_coe_nat q).2 hev.1).mul_left c'
          exact e1.sub e2
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hNe
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm; exact hN hm
        have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m| := Int.one_le_abs hm0
        rw [hm]; push_cast
        rw [show (m : ℝ) + m = 2 * m by ring, abs_mul]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num; linarith
      · exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hN
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hW
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  -- coprimality gives `q = q'`
  have hcop : IsCoprime c q := by
    have : IsCoprime (b : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc
    simpa [c] using this.add_mul_right_left k
  have hcop' : IsCoprime c' q' := by
    have : IsCoprime (b' : ℤ) q' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc'
    simpa [c'] using this.add_mul_right_left k'
  have hd1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
    have : (q : ℤ) ∣ c * q' := ⟨c', by rw [hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hd2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
    have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ c' * q := ⟨c, by rw [← hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) hd1 hd2
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hqq
  have hcc : c = c' := by
    have hq0 : (q : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq0 hcross
  -- `b + kq = b' + k'q` with `0 ≤ b, b' < q`
  have hkk : k = k' := by
    have h : ((b : ℤ) - b') = (k' - k) * q := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
    by_contra hne
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k' - k| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have hlt : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < q := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
    rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq1 : (0:ℤ) < q)] at hlt
    nlinarith
  subst hkk
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have : (b : ℤ) = b' := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

proof_context.conclusion: `α ∈ majorArcs δ₀ R x` iff some `q ≥ 1` with `q̃ ≤ 2R` (`q̃ = q` even, `2q` odd) and `a` coprime to `q` has `|α - a/q| < δ₀R/(q̃x)`, i.e. the odd/even radii of (majdef) in one uniform form.

snippet.text:
theorem mem_majorArcs_iff {δ₀ R x α : ℝ} :
    α ∈ majorArcs δ₀ R x ↔ ∃ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * R ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, IsCoprime a q ∧
      |α - a / q| < wrad δ₀ R x q := by
  simp only [majorArcs, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_Ioo, exists_prop]
  have hodd : ∀ q : ℕ, ¬ Even q → wrad δ₀ R x q = δ₀ * R / (2 * q * x) := fun q h => by
    unfold wrad qt; rw [if_neg h]; push_cast; ring_nf
  have hev : ∀ q : ℕ, Even q → wrad δ₀ R x q = δ₀ * R / (q * x) := fun q h => by
    unfold wrad qt; rw [if_pos h]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqR, ho⟩, a, hcop, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqR, he⟩, a, hcop, h1, h2⟩)
    · have hne : ¬ Even q := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 ho
      refine ⟨q, hq1, ?_, a, hcop, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt; rw [if_neg hne]; push_cast; linarith
      · rw [hodd q hne, abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
    · refine ⟨q, hq1, ?_, a, hcop, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt; rw [if_pos he]; exact hqR
      · rw [hev q he, abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨q, hq1, hqR, a, hcop, h⟩
    rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at h
    by_cases he : Even q
    · right
      refine ⟨q, ⟨hq1, ?_, he⟩, a, hcop, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt at hqR; rw [if_pos he] at hqR; exact hqR
      · rw [hev q he] at h; linarith
      · rw [hev q he] at h; linarith
    · left
      refine ⟨q, ⟨hq1, ?_, Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 he⟩, a, hcop, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt at hqR; rw [if_neg he] at hqR; push_cast at hqR; linarith
      · rw [hodd q he] at h; linarith
      · rw [hodd q he] at h; linarith

proof.summary: Bombieri's identity at a common modulus L expresses φ(q) times the sum over residues through characters, which gives the character expansion of F_R and hence the arc integral.

provenance.method: carried from book Proposition 12.1.2 step 3, the same LaTeX (mapper (sonnet); verifier (sonnet))

annotation.note: [L] does not reduce via (malkr) to sums over `q*` and `r`; it expands `F_R(β)` over all Dirichlet characters mod a common modulus `L`, with the `r`-sum replaced by `G_{c̃}(m_R(β)/c̃)`.

proof_context.conclusion: Bombieri's identity at a common modulus `L`: `φ(q) Σ_{b mod q}^* |S(b/q+β)|²` expressed through characters mod `L` of conductor dividing `q` (the [Bom74, Thm 7A] input).

snippet.text:
/-- **Bombieri's identity, lifted to a common modulus `L`**: for `q ∣ L` and `aₙ` supported on
`n` coprime to `L`,
`φ(q) Σ_{b unit mod q} |S(b/q + β)|² = Σ_{Ψ mod L, cond Ψ ∣ q} w(q, cond Ψ) |S_{Ψ⁻¹}(β)|²`. -/
theorem totient_mul_sum_units_lift {q L : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero L] (hqL : q ∣ L) {a : ℕ → ℂ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖) (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) (β : ℝ) :
    q.totient * ∑ b ∈ (univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter IsUnit, ‖expTsum a ((b.val : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L,
        (if Ψ.conductor ∣ q then wq q Ψ.conductor else 0) * ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hcopq : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n q := fun n hn => (hcop n hn).coprime_dvd_right hqL
  rw [totient_mul_sum_units ha hcopq]
  -- the right side as a sum over the image of `changeLevel`
  have himg : (univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).image (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hqL) =
      univ.filter (fun Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L => Ψ.conductor ∣ q) := by
    ext Ψ
    simp only [mem_image, mem_univ, true_and, mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
      rw [DirichletCharacter.conductor_changeLevel]
      exact DirichletCharacter.conductor_dvd_level ψ
    · intro h
      have hm := (DirichletCharacter.mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd Ψ hqL).2 h
      rw [DirichletCharacter.mem_conductorSet_iff] at hm
      obtain ⟨_, ψ, hψ⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨ψ, hψ.symm⟩
  simp_rw [ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [← sum_filter, ← himg, sum_image fun ψ₁ _ ψ₂ _ h => DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_injective hqL h]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun ψ _ => ?_
  have hS : Schar (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hqL ψ)⁻¹ a β = Schar ψ⁻¹ a β := by
    unfold Schar
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    by_cases han : a n = 0
    · simp [han]
    rw [← map_inv, changeLevel_apply_natCast, if_pos (hcop n han)]
  rw [DirichletCharacter.conductor_changeLevel, norm_sq_gaussSum, hS, wq]

annotation.note: [L] proves disjointness for all `q̃,q̃' ≤ 2Q` (including even `q ≤ 2Q`) and for integer translates of the arcs, by the same bound `|b/q-b'/q'| ≥ 1/qq'` (`2/qq'` both even). Text typo, confirmed by two skeptics and `scripts/checks/steps/proposition_12_1_2_step_11.py`.

proof_context.conclusion: For `δ₀Q² ≤ x/2` and `q̃,q̃' ≤ 2Q`, `w_q + w_{q'} ≤ D/(qq')` with `D = 2` if both `q,q'` even and `1` otherwise.

snippet.text:
/-- `w_q + w_{q'} < D/(qq')` with `D = 2` if `q, q'` are both even and `D = 1` otherwise, when
`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2` and `q̃, q̃' ≤ 2Q`. -/
theorem wrad_add_le {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {q q' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hq' : 1 ≤ q') (hqQ : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) (hqQ' : (qt q' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) :
    wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' ≤ (if Even q ∧ Even q' then 2 else 1) / (q * q') := by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'
  -- `δ₀Q/x ≤ 1/(2Q)`
  have hk : δ₀ * Q / x ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → wrad δ₀ Q x p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < qt p := by have := two_le_qt hp; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < qt p)
    unfold wrad
    rw [show δ₀ * Q / (qt p * x) = δ₀ * Q / x / qt p by field_simp]
    calc δ₀ * Q / x / qt p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) / qt p := by gcongr
      _ = 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by field_simp
  refine (add_le_add (hw q hq) (hw q' hq')).trans ?_
  unfold qt at hqQ hqQ' ⊢
  by_cases he : Even q <;> by_cases he' : Even q' <;> simp only [he, he', if_true, if_false,
    and_self, and_true, and_false] at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;> push_cast at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;>
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] <;>
    nlinarith [mul_pos hqr hqr', mul_pos (mul_pos hqr hqr') hQ]

proof_context.conclusion: For `δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`, arcs at level `Q` (with integer translates) are disjoint: `α-k ∈ J_{q,b}` and `α-k' ∈ J_{q',b'}` force `(q,b,k) = (q',b',k')`, using `|b/q - b'/q'| ≥ 1/qq'` (`≥ 2/qq'` for both even) and `wrad_add_le`.

snippet.text:
/-- **The arcs at level `Q` are disjoint** (`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`): if `α − k ∈ J_{q,b}` and
`α − k' ∈ J_{q',b'}`, then `(q, b, k) = (q', b', k')`. -/
theorem arcs_unique {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {α : ℝ} {q b q' b' : ℕ} {k k' : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ Qset Q) (hb : b ∈ Bset q) (hq' : q' ∈ Qset Q)
    (hb' : b' ∈ Bset q') (h1 : α - k ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q b) (h2 : α - k' ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q' b') :
    q = q' ∧ b = b' ∧ k = k' := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hqQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
  obtain ⟨hq1', hqQ'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq'
  have hq1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1).1
  have hq1' := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1').1
  obtain ⟨hbq, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb
  obtain ⟨hbq', hbc'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb'
  have hbq := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq
  have hbq' := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq'
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1'
  set c : ℤ := b + k * q
  set c' : ℤ := b' + k' * q'
  have hc : (c : ℝ) / q = b / q + k := by simp only [c]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc' : (c' : ℝ) / q' = b' / q' + k' := by simp only [c']; push_cast; field_simp
  have hdist : |(c : ℝ) / q - c' / q'| < wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' := by
    obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    rw [hc, hc', abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hW := wrad_add_le hx hδ hQ hQx hq1 hq1' hqQ hqQ'
  -- `cq' = c'q`
  have hcross : c * q' = c' * q := by
    by_contra hne
    set N : ℤ := c * q' - c' * q
    have hN : N ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hexpr : (c : ℝ) / q - c' / q' = N / (q * q') := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; field_simp
    rw [hexpr, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < q * q')] at hdist
    have hD : (if Even q ∧ Even q' then (2 : ℝ) else 1) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
      split_ifs with hev
      · have hNe : Even N := by
          have e1 : Even (c * q') := ((Int.even_coe_nat q').2 hev.2).mul_left c
          have e2 : Even (c' * q) := ((Int.even_coe_nat q).2 hev.1).mul_left c'
          exact e1.sub e2
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hNe
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm; exact hN hm
        have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m| := Int.one_le_abs hm0
        rw [hm]; push_cast
        rw [show (m : ℝ) + m = 2 * m by ring, abs_mul]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num; linarith
      · exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hN
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hW
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  -- coprimality gives `q = q'`
  have hcop : IsCoprime c q := by
    have : IsCoprime (b : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc
    simpa [c] using this.add_mul_right_left k
  have hcop' : IsCoprime c' q' := by
    have : IsCoprime (b' : ℤ) q' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc'
    simpa [c'] using this.add_mul_right_left k'
  have hd1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
    have : (q : ℤ) ∣ c * q' := ⟨c', by rw [hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hd2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
    have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ c' * q := ⟨c, by rw [← hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) hd1 hd2
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hqq
  have hcc : c = c' := by
    have hq0 : (q : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq0 hcross
  -- `b + kq = b' + k'q` with `0 ≤ b, b' < q`
  have hkk : k = k' := by
    have h : ((b : ℤ) - b') = (k' - k) * q := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
    by_contra hne
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k' - k| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have hlt : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < q := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
    rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq1 : (0:ℤ) < q)] at hlt
    nlinarith
  subst hkk
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have : (b : ℤ) = b' := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

/-- **Disjointness**: for `δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`, `Σ_{q, b} ∫_{J_{q,b}} g ≤ ∫_0^1 g` (`g ≥ 0` continuous
`1`-periodic). -/
theorem sum_arcs_le_integral {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (hper : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hg0 : ∀ α, 0 ≤ g α) {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2) (hw : δ₀ * Q ≤ x) :
    ∑ q ∈ Qset Q, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q x q b, g y ≤ ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, g α := by
  set K : Finset ℤ := {-1, 0, 1}
  have hδQ : 0 ≤ δ₀ * Q := by positivity
  have hmem : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q, 1 ≤ q := fun q hq => (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1).1
  have hbmem : ∀ q b, b ∈ Bset q → b < q := fun q b hb => Finset.mem_range.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hb).1
  have hP : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q, ∀ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q x q b, g y =
      ∑ k ∈ K, ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, (arc δ₀ Q x q b).indicator 1 (α - k) * g α := fun q hq b hb =>
    setIntegral_eq_sum_periodize hg hper measurableSet_Ioo
      (arc_subset hx hδQ hw (hmem q hq) (hbmem q b hb))
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => hP q hq b hb]
  have hint : ∀ (q b : ℕ) (k : ℤ), IntegrableOn
      (fun α => (arc δ₀ Q x q b).indicator 1 (α - k) * g α) (Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro q b k
    refine (hg.integrableOn_Icc (a := 0) (b := 1)).mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self |>.bdd_mul
      (c := 1) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ioo).comp
        (measurable_sub_const _)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun α => by simp only [indicator]; split_ifs <;> simp
  simp_rw [← integral_finset_sum _ fun _ _ => hint _ _ _]
  have hint2 : ∀ q b, IntegrableOn (fun α => ∑ k ∈ K, (arc δ₀ Q x q b).indicator 1 (α - k) * g α)
      (Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) := fun q b => integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hint q b k
  have hmerge : ∑ q ∈ Qset Q, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∑ k ∈ K, (arc δ₀ Q x q b).indicator 1 (α - k) * g α =
      ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∑ q ∈ Qset Q, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∑ k ∈ K,
        (arc δ₀ Q x q b).indicator 1 (α - k) * g α := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ fun q _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hint2 q b]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => (integral_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hint2 q b).symm
  rw [hmerge]
  refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_ ?_ measurableSet_Ioc fun α _ => ?_
  · exact integrable_finset_sum _ fun q _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hint2 q b
  · exact (hg.integrableOn_Icc (a := 0) (b := 1)).mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  · simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have := sum_arc_indicator_le_one hx hδ hQ hQx α
    nlinarith [hg0 α]

/-- **Plancherel** for `ℓ¹` coefficients. -/
theorem setIntegral_norm_sq_expTsum {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖) :
    ∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  set B := ∑' n, ‖a n‖
  -- pointwise convergence of the partial sums
  have hpt : ∀ α : ℝ, Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2)) := by
    intro α
    have hs : Summable fun n => a n * e (n * α) :=
      Summable.of_norm (by simpa only [norm_mul_e] using ha)
    have := (hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    exact ((continuous_norm.pow 2).tendsto _).comp this
  have hlim := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (F := fun (X : ℕ) (α : ℝ) => ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2) (f := fun α => ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2)
    (fun _ => B ^ 2)
    (fun X => ((continuous_expSum X a).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const _)
    (fun X => Eventually.of_forall fun α => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_expSum_le X ha α) 2)
    (Eventually.of_forall hpt)
  have hfun : (fun X : ℕ => ∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2) =
      fun X => ∑ n ∈ range (X + 1), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := funext fun X => setIntegral_norm_sq_expSum X a
  rw [hfun] at hlim
  have h2 := (summable_norm_sq_of_summable_norm ha).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.comp
    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim h2

    have ha31 : 31 < a := by omega

    exact ghat_tail_anti hb37 hab
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 31 a with ha31 | ha31
    · -- `b ≤ 31 < a`

        by_contra h; interval_cases a <;> norm_num at ha
      have h1 : gHatQ a ≤ 1.1208 := by
        rw [ghat_of_gt ha31]; exact ghat_tail_le ha37
      have h2 : 1.12235 ≤ gHatQ b := by
        unfold gHatQ; split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem IHk_step {k : ℕ} (hk : 11 ≤ k) (ih : IHk k) : IHk (k + 1) := by

  set p := Nat.nth Nat.Prime k
  have hpp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_nth_prime k
  have hp37 : 37 ≤ p := by
    have := Nat.nth_monotone Nat.infinite_setOfPred_prime hk
    rw [nth_primes.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2] at this; exact this
  have hp' : (37 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp37
  have hprim0 : (0 : ℝ) < primk k := by
    unfold primk; push_cast
    exact prod_pos fun i _ => by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_nth_prime i).pos
  -- `κ` increases
  have hκ' : kapk k (primk k) ≤ kapk (k + 1) (primk (k + 1)) := by
    unfold kapk
    rw [Sk_succ, primk_succ]
    have hsh : shat p = Real.log p / p := by unfold shat; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [hsh]; push_cast
    rw [Real.log_mul hprim0.ne' (by positivity)]
    have hlp : 0 ≤ Real.log p := Real.log_natCast_nonneg p
    have : Real.log p / p ≤ Real.log p := div_le_self hlp (by linarith)
    linarith
  refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hκ', ?_⟩
  rw [Gk_succ]
  have hg := ghat_pow_le hp37
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ gHatQ p := by linarith [one_le_ghat p]
  have hsq : ((primk (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = ((primk k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [primk_succ]; push_cast; ring

    _ ≤ ((103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * ((primk k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * kapk k (primk k) ^ 21) * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hmain hg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (((primk k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          kapk (k + 1) (primk (k + 1)) ^ 21 := by

        have h0 : 0 ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * ((primk k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity

    lamQ q ^ 7 ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by

  have hq' : (22000000000 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  set k := q.primeFactors.card
  have hlq : 23.8143 ≤ Real.log q := log_Q1_ge.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hq')
  have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lamQ q := by
    unfold lamQ
    have := kapQ_pos hq1; have := qphi_pos hq1; have := f1q_pos q
    positivity
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 11 with hk | hk
  · -- `k ≤ 10`
    have hG : Gk k ≤ Gk 10 := by
      unfold Gk
      exact prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le₀ (range_subset_range.2 (by omega))
        (fun i _ => by linarith [one_le_ghat (Nat.nth Nat.Prime i)]) fun i _ _ => one_le_ghat _
    have hS : Sk k ≤ Sk 10 := by
      unfold Sk
      exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (range_subset_range.2 (by omega))
        fun i _ _ => shat_nonneg _
    set κ0 : ℝ := 0.3726 * (23.8143 - (2 * 1.098613 / 3 + 1.609442 / 5 + 1.94597 / 7 +
      2.397896 / 11 + 2.564952 / 13 + 2.833241 / 17 + 2.944498 / 19 + 3.135495 / 23 +
      3.367296 / 29)) + 0.0274177 with hκ0def
    have hκ0 : 0 < κ0 := by norm_num [hκ0def]
    have hκ : κ0 ≤ kapk k q := by
      unfold kapk; have := Sk_10_le; rw [hκ0def]; nlinarith
    obtain ⟨hlam, -⟩ := lamQ_le_k hq1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hκ0 hκ)
    have hG0 : 0 ≤ Gk k := by
      unfold Gk; exact prod_nonneg fun i _ => by linarith [one_le_ghat (Nat.nth Nat.Prime i)]
    have h1 : lamQ q ≤ (7.4527 * Gk 10 / κ0) ^ 3 :=
      hlam.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hG0) (hκ0.le.trans hκ))
        (div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hG0.trans hG)) (by linarith) hκ0 hκ) 3)
    have h2 := base_10 (κ := κ0) le_rfl
    calc lamQ q ^ 7 ≤ ((7.4527 * Gk 10 / κ0) ^ 3) ^ 7 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlam0 h1 7
      _ = (7.4527 * Gk 10) ^ 21 / κ0 ^ 21 := by rw [← pow_mul, div_pow]
      _ ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (22000000000 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; exact h2
      _ ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  · -- `k ≥ 11`
    obtain ⟨hκ, hmain⟩ := IHk_all hk
    have hprim : ((primk k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by
      have hPp : ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p.Prime := fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
      have h2 := (TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.exch q.primeFactors hPp).2

      unfold primk; exact_mod_cast h2.trans h3
    have hprim0 : (0 : ℝ) < primk k := by
      unfold primk; push_cast
      exact prod_pos fun i _ => by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_nth_prime i).pos
    have hκq : kapk k (primk k) ≤ kapk k q := by
      unfold kapk; have := Real.log_le_log hprim0 hprim; linarith
    obtain ⟨hlam, -⟩ := lamQ_le_k hq1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hκq)
    have hG0 : 0 ≤ Gk k := by
      unfold Gk; exact prod_nonneg fun i _ => by linarith [one_le_ghat (Nat.nth Nat.Prime i)]
    have h1 : lamQ q ≤ (7.4527 * Gk k / kapk k (primk k)) ^ 3 :=
      hlam.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hG0) (hκ.le.trans hκq))

          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; exact hmain

/-- **Large `q`**: for `q ≥ 2.2·10¹⁰` and `1 ≤ R < λ(q)`, `log q + 1.039 R ≤ 1.03 (qR)^{2/9}`. -/
theorem large_q_hS {q : ℕ} (hq : 22000000000 ≤ q) {R : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R < lamQ q) :
    Real.log q + 1.039 * R ≤ 1.03 * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
  have hq' : (22000000000 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hlam := lamQ_pow_le hq
  have hR7 : R ^ 7 ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ hR0.le hR.le 7).trans hlam
  -- `R^{7/9} ≤ (103/120) q^{2/9}`
  have h79 : R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hR7 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 9)
    have eL : (R ^ 7) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) = R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hR0.le]; norm_num
    have eR : ((103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) =
        (103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity), ← Real.rpow_natCast,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_natCast (q : ℝ), ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
      norm_num
    rwa [eL, eR] at h
  have hsplit : R = R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hR0]; norm_num
  have hqR : ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) = (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) :=
    Real.mul_rpow hq0.le hR0.le
  have hRle : R ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    rw [hqR]
    calc R = R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := hsplit
      _ ≤ R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * ((103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9)) :=

theorem Rs_hasDerivAt {B s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ Real.log 8 + s) (hB : s < B) :
    HasDerivAt (Rs B) (0.27125 * ((B + Real.log 8) / ((B - s) * (2 * B - s + Real.log 8)))) s := by
  have hBs : B - s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hu := ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add (Real.log 8)).div
    (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub B).const_mul 2) (by simp; exact hBs)
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + (Real.log 8 + s) / (2 * (B - s)) := by
    have : 0 ≤ (Real.log 8 + s) / (2 * (B - s)) := div_nonneg hs (by linarith)
    linarith
  have h2 : 2 * B - s + Real.log 8 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold Rs
  refine ((((hu.const_add 1).log hpos.ne').const_mul 0.27125).add_const 0.41415).congr_deriv ?_
  simp only [id, Pi.div_apply]
  field_simp
  ring

      (1 + t) * (∫ α in A, ‖expTsum (a₁ x) α‖ ^ 2 * v α) +
        (1 + 1 / t) * ∫ α in A, v α * ‖expTsum (a₂ x) α‖ ^ 2 := by
    have i1 : IntegrableOn (fun α => ‖expTsum (a₁ x) α‖ ^ 2 * v α) A :=

    have i2 : IntegrableOn (fun α => v α * ‖expTsum (a₂ x) α‖ ^ 2) A :=
      integrableOn_Ioc_of_continuous (hv.mul c2) A hAsub
    have hcS : Continuous fun α => ‖S etaStar x α‖ * ‖S etaPlus x α‖ ^ 2 :=
      hv.mul ((TernaryGoldbach.continuous_expTsum (Helfgott.summable_etaPlus hx0)).norm.pow 2)
    have e : (1 + t) * (∫ α in A, ‖expTsum (a₁ x) α‖ ^ 2 * v α) +
        (1 + 1 / t) * ∫ α in A, v α * ‖expTsum (a₂ x) α‖ ^ 2 =

citation.title: The ternary Goldbach conjecture is true

proof.summary: A layer decomposition bounds the integral outside the arcs by a sum over r of g(n) times the increments, plus a last-layer term, giving the bound by ∑f(n)g(n).

provenance.method: carried from book Proposition 13.1.2 step 6, the same LaTeX (mapper (sonnet); verifier (sonnet))

annotation.note: Unnormalized; derived by peeling layers (layer_le) rather than by a single decomposition.

proof_context.conclusion: ∫_{(M r₀)ᶜ} u v ≤ Σ_{r₀≤n<k} g n (I(n+1)−I n)+∫_{(M k)ᶜ} u v.

snippet.text:
/-- Peeling off one level: `∫_{(M r₀)ᶜ} u v ≤ Σ_{r₀ ≤ n < k} g(n)(I(n+1) − I(n)) + ∫_{(M k)ᶜ} u v`
with `I(n) = ∫_{M n} u`. -/
theorem layer_le {u v : Ω → ℝ} (hu : Integrable u μ) (huv : Integrable (fun ω => u ω * v ω) μ)
    (hu0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ u ω) {M : ℕ → Set Ω} (hM : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (M n)) (hmono : Monotone M)
    {g : ℕ → ℝ} {r₀ K : ℕ} (hv : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n < K → ∀ ω ∉ M n, v ω ≤ g n) :
    ∀ k, r₀ ≤ k → k ≤ K → ∫ ω in (M r₀)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Ico r₀ k, g n * ((∫ ω in M (n + 1), u ω ∂μ) - ∫ ω in M n, u ω ∂μ) +
        ∫ ω in (M k)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ := by
  intro k hk
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ k hk ih =>
    intro hkK
    have ih := ih (by omega)
    rw [sum_Ico_succ_top hk]
    have hsplit : (M k)ᶜ = (M (k + 1) \ M k) ∪ (M (k + 1))ᶜ := by
      ext ω; simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_union, mem_sdiff]
      have : ω ∈ M k → ω ∈ M (k + 1) := fun h => hmono (show k ≤ k + 1 by omega) h
      tauto
    have hdisj : Disjoint (M (k + 1) \ M k) (M (k + 1))ᶜ :=
      disjoint_compl_right.mono_left sdiff_subset
    have e1 : ∫ ω in (M k)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ = (∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω * v ω ∂μ) +
        ∫ ω in (M (k + 1))ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ := by
      rw [hsplit, setIntegral_union hdisj (hM _).compl huv.integrableOn huv.integrableOn]
    have e2 : ∫ ω in M (k + 1), u ω ∂μ = (∫ ω in M k, u ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω ∂μ := by
      have : M (k + 1) = M k ∪ (M (k + 1) \ M k) := (union_sdiff_cancel (hmono (by omega))).symm
      conv_lhs => rw [this]
      rw [setIntegral_union disjoint_sdiff_right ((hM _).diff (hM _)) hu.integrableOn hu.integrableOn]
    have h3 : ∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, g k * u ω ∂μ := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on huv.integrableOn (hu.integrableOn.const_mul _)
        ((hM _).diff (hM _)) fun ω hω => ?_
      rw [mul_comm (g k)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv k hk (by omega) ω hω.2) (hu0 ω)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h3
    have e4 : g k * ((∫ ω in M (k + 1), u ω ∂μ) - ∫ ω in M k, u ω ∂μ) =
        g k * ∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω ∂μ := by rw [e2]; ring
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: With k=r₁ and the last-layer bound, ∫_{(M r₀)ᶜ} u v ≤ Σ_{n∈Icc r₀ r₁} f n g n (hsum).

snippet.text:
have hlast : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤ g r₁ * ((∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁) := by
    have h1 : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, g r₁ * u ω ∂μ := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on huv.integrableOn (hu.integrableOn.const_mul _)
        (hM _).compl fun ω hω => ?_
      rw [mul_comm (g r₁)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv r₁ h01 le_rfl ω hω) (hu0 ω)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω ∂μ = (∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁ := by
      have := integral_add_compl (hM r₁) hu
      simp only [hI]; linarith
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hl := layer_le hu huv hu0 hM hmono (K := r₁) (fun n h1 h2 => hv n h1 h2.le) r₁ h01 le_rfl
  -- write it as `Σ_{n ∈ [r₀, r₁]} f(n) g(n)`
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n < r₁ then I (n + 1) - I n else (∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁ with hf
  have hsum : ∑ n ∈ Ico r₀ r₁, g n * (I (n + 1) - I n) + g r₁ * ((∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁) =
      ∑ n ∈ Icc r₀ r₁, f n * g n := by
    rw [← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, sum_Ico_succ_top (by omega)]
    congr 1
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      have : n < r₁ := (mem_Ico.1 hn).2
      simp only [hf, ite_eq_left this]; ring
    · simp only [hf, lt_irrefl, ite_false]; ring

/-- Dirichlet: for `Q ≥ 1` there is an approximation `2α = a/q + δ/x (mod 1)` with `q ≤ Q`,
`|δ/x| ≤ 1/qQ`. -/
theorem exists_approx2 (α : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    ∃ (δ : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Approx2 α x δ a q Q := by
  set n := ⌊Q⌋₊
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.floor_pos.2 hQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrden⟩ := Real.exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le (2 * α) hn
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < r.den := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hcast : (r : ℝ) = r.num / r.den := Rat.cast_def r
  refine ⟨x * (2 * α - r.num / r.den), r.num, r.den, hq1, ?_, ⟨0, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]; exact r.reduced
  · field_simp; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx.ne', ← hcast]
    refine hr.trans ?_
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    rw [mul_comm (r.den : ℝ)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.lt_floor_add_one Q).le hq0.le
  · exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrden) (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))

theorem mem_majorArcs_of_approx {α y δ δ₀ r Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (h : Approx2 α y δ a q Q) (hqr : (q : ℝ) ≤ r) (hδ : |δ| * q < δ₀ * r) :
    α ∈ majorArcs δ₀ r y := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hcop, ⟨k, hk⟩, -, -⟩ := h
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  set m : ℤ := a + k * q with hm
  have hcopm : IsCoprime m (q : ℤ) := by
    simpa [hm] using hcop.add_mul_right_left k
  have hα : α = m / (2 * q) + δ / (2 * y) := by
    have : α = (a / q + δ / y + k) / 2 := by linarith
    rw [this, hm]; push_cast
    field_simp; ring
  -- `|δ/(2y)| < δ₀ r/(2 q y)`
  have hrad : |δ / (2 * y)| < δ₀ * r / (2 * q * y) := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * y), div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)
      (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hmem : ∀ (c ρ : ℝ), |α - c| < ρ → α ∈ Set.Ioo (c - ρ) (c + ρ) := fun c ρ h => by
    rw [abs_lt] at h; constructor <;> linarith
  by_cases hpar : Odd q ∧ Even m
  · obtain ⟨hqo, b, hb⟩ := hpar
    left
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqr, hqo⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, ?_, hmem _ _ ?_⟩⟩
    · have : IsCoprime (2 * b) (q : ℤ) := by rw [two_mul, ← hb]; exact hcopm
      exact this.of_mul_left_right
    · rw [hα, show (m : ℝ) = 2 * b by rw [hb]; push_cast; ring]
      convert hrad using 2; field_simp; ring
  · right
    have hmo : Odd m := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd q with hqe | hqo
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hqe
        refine Int.not_even_iff_odd.1 fun hme => ?_
        have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ m := hme.two_dvd
        have h2q : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (q : ℤ) := ⟨j, by rw [hj]; push_cast; ring⟩
        have := Int.isUnit_iff.1 (hcopm.isUnit_of_dvd' h2 h2q)
        omega
      · exact Int.not_even_iff_odd.1 fun hme => hpar ⟨hqo, hme⟩
    have hcop2 : IsCoprime m ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      push_cast; exact (Int.isCoprime_two_right.mpr hmo).mul_right hcopm
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨2 * q, ⟨by omega, by push_cast; linarith, even_two_mul q⟩,
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨m, hcop2, hmem _ _ ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hα]; push_cast
    convert hrad using 2; field_simp; ring

    have h9 : (8200 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * T / 4.008 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
