    (hn : 670 ≤ n) (hny : n ≤ (x / κ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) (hny' : 2.16e20 * n ≤ 670 * (x / κ))
    (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n (x / κ)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ghatY (x / κ) n := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  set w₀ := 670 / n with hw₀_def
  have hw₀ : 0 < w₀ := by positivity
  have hw₀1 : w₀ ≤ 1 := by rw [hw₀_def, div_le_one hn0]; exact hn
  have hw₀n : w₀ * n = 670 := by rw [hw₀_def]; field_simp
  -- `n ≤ y^{1/3}/6` makes `w₀ y` huge
  have hw₀y : 2.16e20 ≤ w₀ * y := by
    rw [hw₀_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hn0]; linarith
  set M := max (gx y n) (hfun y) with hM
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => M * max 1 (1 / w) with hG
  have hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Ici w₀) := by
    refine (integrable_phi.const_mul (|M| * max 1 (1 / w₀))).integrableOn.mono' ?_ ?_
    · exact ((measurable_const.mul (measurable_const.max (measurable_const.div measurable_id))).mul
        (by unfold phi; fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ici).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w (hw : w₀ ≤ w) => ?_)
      have hw0 : 0 < w := lt_of_lt_of_le hw₀ hw
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (phi_nonneg w),
        abs_of_nonneg (le_max_of_le_left zero_le_one : (0:ℝ) ≤ max 1 (1 / w))]
      have : max 1 (1 / w) ≤ max 1 (1 / w₀) := max_le_max le_rfl (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hw₀ hw)
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg M)
      nlinarith [phi_nonneg w]
  have hpw : ∀ w ∈ Ici w₀, ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G w * (w * y) := by
    intro w (hw : w₀ ≤ w)
    have hw0 : 0 < w := lt_of_lt_of_le hw₀ hw
    have hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n := by
      have : w₀ ≤ min 1 w := le_min hw₀1 hw
      nlinarith
    have hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y := hw₀y.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw hy0.le)
    refine norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem hy0 hα hw0 hz hlow (fun _ => ?_) ?_
    · exact (gx_scale_le hy0 hw0 hlow hny).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_of_le_left zero_le_one))
    · rw [hfun_mul_self (by linarith)]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by linarith)
      exact (hfun_scale_le (exp_nine_le_y hy) hw0 (exp_nine_le.trans (by linarith))).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_of_le_left zero_le_one))
  have key := norm_S_etaStar_le_of_pointwise_Ici hx hw₀ hpw hGi
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (hfun_nonneg (by linarith)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hint : ∫ w in Ici w₀, G w * phi w ≤ 1.398 * M := by
    have : ∫ w in Ici w₀, G w * phi w = M * ∫ w in Ici w₀, max 1 (1 / w) * phi w := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]; congr 1; ext w; simp only [hG]; ring
    rw [this]
    have := integral_max_inv_phi_le hw₀ hw₀1
    nlinarith
  have hI2 := integral_phi_Ioo_le hw₀.le
  refine key.trans ?_
  unfold ghatY
  rw [← hM, ← hw₀_def]
  gcongr
  linarith

    linarith

    unfold psiN at h1
    have : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    linarith

theorem norm_S_etaStar_le_uniform {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ 22.75 * (x / κ) := by
  have hκ : (0:ℝ) < κ := by rw [Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  have hy0 : 0 < x / κ := div_pos hx hκ
  have hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => (17 : ℝ) * phi w) (Ici 1) :=
    (integrable_phi.const_mul 17).integrableOn
  have key := norm_S_etaStar_le_of_pointwise_Ici (G := fun _ => 17) (α := α) hx one_pos
    (fun w (hw : 1 ≤ w) => norm_S_eta2_le_trivial (mul_pos (by linarith) hy0) α) hGi
  have h1 := integral_phi_Ici_one_le
  have h2 := integral_phi_Ioo_le (w₀ := 1) zero_le_one
  rw [integral_const_mul] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  have h3 : (17 * ∫ w in Ici (1:ℝ), phi w) + 17 * ∫ w in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, phi w ≤ 22.75 := by
    norm_num at h2; linarith
  calc x / κ * ((17 * ∫ w in Ici (1:ℝ), phi w) + 17 * ∫ w in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, phi w)
      ≤ x / κ * 22.75 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hy0.le
    _ = 22.75 * (x / κ) := by ring

/-- **[H, Cor. 12.2.5, (12.42)]** (with `δ₀ ≥ 2`).  Let `Q₀ ≥ 10⁵`, `δ₀ ≥ 2`,

`∫_{𝔐_{δ₀,Q₀}} |S|² ≤ (log 2Q₀ + 2)/(log 2Q + c_E) Σ|aₙ|²`. -/
theorem cor_12_2_5 {x δ₀ Q₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀) (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hx : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀))
    (hρ : 2 * Q₀ ≤ (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) ^ (0.6 : ℝ)) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by

  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by positivity) hx
  have hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hx
  refine prop_12_1_2 ha hδ₀ (by linarith) ?_ fun q hq _ hq2 s hs hsq => ?_
  · have h1 : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by nlinarith) hx
    have h2 : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = x / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  · have h2Q₀ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Q₀ := by linarith
    have hlog : Real.log (2 * Q₀) ≤ 0.6 * Real.log (2 * Q) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log h2Q₀ hρ
      rwa [Real.log_rpow (by nlinarith)] at this
    exact prop_12_2_4 (by linarith) (by linarith) hlog hq hq2 hs hsq

/-- **[H, Prop. 13.1.2]**, discrete form (see the module docstring). -/
theorem prop_13_1_2 {u v : Ω → ℝ} (hu : Integrable u μ) (huv : Integrable (fun ω => u ω * v ω) μ)
    (hu0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ u ω) {M : ℕ → Set Ω} (hM : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (M n)) (hmono : Monotone M)
    {g H : ℕ → ℝ} {r₀ r₁ : ℕ} (h01 : r₀ ≤ r₁)
    (hg : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n < r₁ → g (n + 1) ≤ g n) (hg0 : 0 ≤ g r₁)
    (hv : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n ≤ r₁ → ∀ ω ∉ M n, v ω ≤ g n)
    (hH : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n < r₁ → ∫ ω in M (n + 1), u ω ∂μ ≤ H n) (hH₁ : ∫ ω, u ω ∂μ ≤ H r₁) :
    ∫ ω in (M r₀)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤
      g r₀ * (H r₀ - ∫ ω in M r₀, u ω ∂μ) + ∑ n ∈ Ioc r₀ r₁, g n * (H n - H (n - 1)) := by
  set I : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ∫ ω in M n, u ω ∂μ with hI
  -- the last layer
  have hlast : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤ g r₁ * ((∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁) := by
    have h1 : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, g r₁ * u ω ∂μ := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on huv.integrableOn (hu.integrableOn.const_mul _)
        (hM _).compl fun ω hω => ?_
      rw [mul_comm (g r₁)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv r₁ h01 le_rfl ω hω) (hu0 ω)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ ω in (M r₁)ᶜ, u ω ∂μ = (∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁ := by
      have := integral_add_compl (hM r₁) hu
      simp only [hI]; linarith
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hl := layer_le hu huv hu0 hM hmono (K := r₁) (fun n h1 h2 => hv n h1 h2.le) r₁ h01 le_rfl
  -- write it as `Σ_{n ∈ [r₀, r₁]} f(n) g(n)`
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n < r₁ then I (n + 1) - I n else (∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁ with hf
  have hsum : ∑ n ∈ Ico r₀ r₁, g n * (I (n + 1) - I n) + g r₁ * ((∫ ω, u ω ∂μ) - I r₁) =
      ∑ n ∈ Icc r₀ r₁, f n * g n := by
    rw [← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, sum_Ico_succ_top (by omega)]
    congr 1
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      have : n < r₁ := (mem_Ico.1 hn).2
      simp only [hf, ite_eq_left this]; ring
    · simp only [hf, lt_irrefl, ite_false]; ring
  -- partial sums telescope
  have hS : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n ≤ r₁ → ∑ m ∈ Icc r₀ n, f m ≤ H n - I r₀ := by
    intro n hn hn1
    have tele : ∀ k, r₀ ≤ k → k ≤ r₁ → ∑ m ∈ Ico r₀ k, f m = I k - I r₀ := by
      intro k hk hk1
      induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => simp
      | succ k hk ih =>
        rw [sum_Ico_succ_top hk, ih (by omega)]
        simp only [hf, ite_eq_left (show k < r₁ by omega)]; ring
    rw [← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, sum_Ico_succ_top hn, tele n hn hn1]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hn1 with h | h
    · simp only [hf, ite_eq_left h]; linarith [hH n hn h]
    · subst h; simp only [hf, lt_irrefl, ite_false]; linarith
  have habel := abel_le (F := fun n => H n - I r₀) h01 hg hg0 hS
  have e3 : ∑ n ∈ Ioc r₀ r₁, g n * ((H n - I r₀) - (H (n - 1) - I r₀)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc r₀ r₁, g n * (H n - H (n - 1)) := sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by ring
  rw [e3] at habel
  linarith

    (hg : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n < r₁ → g (n + 1) ≤ g n) (hg0 : 0 ≤ g r₁)
    (hv₀ : ∀ α ∉ majorArcs 8 r₀ x, ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ g r₀)
    (hv : ∀ n, r₀ < n → n ≤ r₁ → ∀ α ∉ majorArcs 8 n (x / κ), ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ g n) :
    ∫ α in Ioc 0 1 \ majorArcs 8 r₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 * ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤

  have hcu : Continuous fun α => ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 :=
    (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_expTsum ha.2).norm.pow 2
  have hcv : Continuous fun α => ‖S etaStar x α‖ :=
    (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_expTsum (summable_etaStar hx)).norm
  have hint : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, Continuous f → Integrable f μ := fun hf =>
    hf.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hres : ∀ (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), MeasurableSet s →
      ∫ α in s, f α ∂μ = ∫ α in Ioc 0 1 ∩ s, f α := fun s f hs => by
    rw [Measure.restrict_restrict hs, inter_comm]
  have hv' : ∀ n, r₀ ≤ n → n ≤ r₁ → ∀ α ∉ M n, ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ g n := by
    intro n hn hn1 α hα

theorem T_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) : ∑' n, ‖a₁ x n‖ ^ 2 ≤ sig x * x := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨E₂, hE₂, heq⟩ := prop_7_1_5 (x := x) (by linarith)
  have hlx : 0 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hpt : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a₁ x n‖ ^ 2 ≤ Λ n * Real.log n * etaPlus (n / x) ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    unfold a₁
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime h.1, sq]
    · simp only [norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow]
      have := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := n)
      have : 0 ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_natCast_nonneg n
      positivity
  have hs1 : Summable fun n => ‖a₁ x n‖ ^ 2 :=
    TernaryGoldbach.summable_norm_sq_of_summable_norm (summable_a₁ hx0)
  have hs2 : Summable fun n : ℕ => Λ n * Real.log n * etaPlus (n / x) ^ 2 := by
    by_contra hns
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hns] at heq
    -- the main term is positive
    have : 0 < 0.640206 * x * Real.log x - 0.021095 * x + E₂ * x * Real.log x := by
      have hl : 60 ≤ Real.log x := by
        rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hx0]
        have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
        calc rexp 60 = rexp 1 ^ 60 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
          _ ≤ 2.7182818286 ^ 60 := by gcongr
          _ ≤ 4.9e26 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ x := hx
      have hE : -(2e-6 + 366.91 / √x) ≤ E₂ := (abs_le.1 hE₂).1
      have hsx : 0 < √x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx0

annotation.note: [L] proves the same two-step bound with weaker constants: `ψ-θ+log 2 ≤ 1.6001 √N` for `1.4263 √N` and `ψ ≤ 1.387 N` for `1.03883 N`, product `≤ 2.2194 N^{3/2}` not `1.48169`. The RS62 `ψ(y)<1.03883 y` is in [L] (`Prelim.sum_vonMangoldt_lt`) but not used here.

proof_context.conclusion: `∑_{n≤N, n even or non-prime} Λ(n) ≤ ψ(N) - θ(N) + log 2` (`ΛBad` = Λ off odd primes).

snippet.text:
theorem sum_ΛBad_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ΛBad n ≤ psi N - theta N + Real.log 2 := by
  classical
  have hsplit : psi N - theta N = ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), if n.Prime then 0 else Λ n := by
    rw [psi, theta, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have hlog2 : ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), (if n = 2 then Real.log 2 else 0) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    rw [sum_ite_eq' (range (N + 1)) 2 (fun _ => Real.log 2)]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  rw [hsplit]
  refine le_trans ?_ (add_le_add le_rfl hlog2)
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  refine sum_le_sum fun n _ => ?_
  unfold ΛBad Good
  have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  by_cases hp : n.Prime
  · by_cases ho : Odd n
    · simp only [hp, ho, and_self, ite_true]
      split_ifs <;> linarith
    · have : n = 2 := (hp.eq_two_or_odd').resolve_right ho
      subst this
      simp [hp, ho, vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
  · simp only [hp, false_and, ite_false, ite_true]
    split_ifs <;> simp [vonMangoldt_nonneg, h2]

annotation.note: Lean gets $\ge(1.049-1.0376)x^2/\kappa-6.7\cdot10^6N^{3/2}\log N>0$ (constants $0.0114$ and $6.7\cdot10^6$ for $0.08433$ and $7.3306$); `final_inequality` proves the $7.3306$ comparison, but no $0.000422N^2$ bound is stated, only positivity.

snippet.text:
/-- The final numerical step of [H, §14.4]: for `N ≥ 10²⁷`,
`7.3306 N^{3/2} log N < (1.049 - 1.0376) x²/κ`. -/
theorem final_inequality (N : ℕ) (hN : 10 ^ 27 ≤ N) :
    7.3306 * (N * √N) * Real.log N < (1.049 - 1.0376) * xOf N ^ 2 / κ := by
  obtain ⟨hc0, hc1⟩ := xOf_denom_bounds
  set c := 2 + 9 / (196 * √(2 * Real.pi)) with hc
  have hNr : (10 : ℝ) ^ 27 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hNr
  set s := √(√(N : ℝ)) with hs
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = √(N : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hs4 : s ^ 4 = (N : ℝ) := by
    rw [show s ^ 4 = (s ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring, hs2, Real.sq_sqrt hN0.le]
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN0)
  have hsbig : (10 : ℝ) ^ 6 ≤ s := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : s ^ 4 < ((10 : ℝ) ^ 6) ^ 4 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ h hs0.le (by norm_num)
    rw [hs4] at this
    linarith [show ((10 : ℝ) ^ 6) ^ 4 ≤ 10 ^ 27 by norm_num]
  have hlog : Real.log N = 4 * Real.log s := by
    rw [← hs4, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have hlogs : Real.log s ≤ s := (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hs0).trans (by linarith)
  have hx : xOf N ^ 2 = s ^ 8 / c ^ 2 := by
    rw [xOf, div_pow, ← hs4]; ring
  rw [hx, hlog, ← hs2, ← hs4]
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 ≤ 4.0804 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul hc1 hc1 hc0.le (by norm_num)]
  have hc2' : 0 < c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have lhs : 7.3306 * (s ^ 4 * s ^ 2) * (4 * Real.log s) ≤ 29.3224 * s ^ 7 := by
    have : s ^ 4 * s ^ 2 * Real.log s ≤ s ^ 4 * s ^ 2 * s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogs (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have rhs : 0.0114 * s ^ 8 / (4.0804 * 49) ≤ (1.049 - 1.0376) * (s ^ 8 / c ^ 2) / κ := by
    rw [κ]
    have : s ^ 8 / 4.0804 ≤ s ^ 8 / c ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hc2' hc2
    have h8 : 0 ≤ s ^ 8 := by positivity
    calc 0.0114 * s ^ 8 / (4.0804 * 49) = (1.049 - 1.0376) * (s ^ 8 / 4.0804) / 49 := by
          ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have key : 29.3224 * s ^ 7 < 0.0114 * s ^ 8 / (4.0804 * 49) := by
    have h7 : 0 < s ^ 7 := by positivity
    have : s ^ 8 = s * s ^ 7 := by ring
    rw [this, lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsbig h7.le]
  linarith

snippet.text:
/-- The final inequality with the cruder constant that comes from the easy sup-norm bounds
(`Helfgott/SupNorms.lean`) and elementary Chebyshev bounds (`Helfgott/Chebyshev.lean`): for `N ≥ 10²⁷`,
`6.7 · 10⁶ · N^{3/2} log N < (1.049 - 1.0376) x²/κ`. -/
theorem final_inequality_crude (N : ℕ) (hN : 10 ^ 27 ≤ N) :
    6.7e6 * (N * √N) * Real.log N < (1.049 - 1.0376) * xOf N ^ 2 / κ := by
  obtain ⟨hc0, hc1⟩ := xOf_denom_bounds
  set c := 2 + 9 / (196 * √(2 * Real.pi)) with hc
  have hNr : (10 : ℝ) ^ 27 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hNr
  -- `v = N^{1/64}`.
  set a := √(N : ℝ)
  set b := √a
  set d := √b
  set f := √d
  set g := √f
  set v := √g
  have ha : a ^ 2 = N := Real.sq_sqrt hN0.le
  have hb : b ^ 2 = a := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hd : d ^ 2 = b := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hf : f ^ 2 = d := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hg : g ^ 2 = f := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hv : v ^ 2 = g := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hv32 : v ^ 32 = a := by
    rw [show v ^ 32 = ((((v ^ 2) ^ 2) ^ 2) ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring, hv, hg, hf, hd, hb]
  have hv64 : v ^ 64 = (N : ℝ) := by
    rw [show v ^ 64 = (v ^ 32) ^ 2 by ring, hv32, ha]
  have hv0 : 0 < v := by
    have h1 : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN0
    have h2 : 0 < b := Real.sqrt_pos.2 h1
    have h3 : 0 < d := Real.sqrt_pos.2 h2
    have h4 : 0 < f := Real.sqrt_pos.2 h3
    have h5 : 0 < g := Real.sqrt_pos.2 h4
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 h5
  have hvbig : (2.64 : ℝ) ≤ v := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : v ^ 64 < (2.64 : ℝ) ^ 64 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ h hv0.le (by norm_num)
    rw [hv64] at this
    linarith [show (2.64 : ℝ) ^ 64 ≤ 10 ^ 27 by norm_num]
  have hlog : Real.log N = 64 * Real.log v := by
    rw [← hv64, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  -- `log v ≤ v/e ≤ v/2.7` (from `log(v/e) ≤ v/e - 1`).
  have hlogv : Real.log v ≤ v / 2.7 := by
    have he := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
    have he0 : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
    have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hv0 he0)
    rw [Real.log_div hv0.ne' he0.ne', Real.log_exp] at h1
    have : v / Real.exp 1 ≤ v / 2.7 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hv0.le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hx : xOf N ^ 2 = v ^ 128 / c ^ 2 := by
    rw [xOf, div_pow, ← hv64]; ring
  rw [hx, hlog, ← hv32, ← hv64]
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 ≤ 4.0804 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul hc1 hc1 hc0.le (by norm_num)]
  have hc2' : 0 < c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have lhs : 6.7e6 * (v ^ 64 * v ^ 32) * (64 * Real.log v) ≤ 1.589e8 * v ^ 97 := by
    have : v ^ 64 * v ^ 32 * Real.log v ≤ v ^ 64 * v ^ 32 * (v / 2.7) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogv (by positivity)
    have e : v ^ 64 * v ^ 32 * (v / 2.7) = v ^ 97 / 2.7 := by ring
    have h97 : 0 ≤ v ^ 97 := by positivity
    rw [e] at this
    rw [show 6.7e6 * (v ^ 64 * v ^ 32) * (64 * Real.log v) = 4.288e8 * (v ^ 64 * v ^ 32 * Real.log v)
      by ring]
    calc 4.288e8 * (v ^ 64 * v ^ 32 * Real.log v) ≤ 4.288e8 * (v ^ 97 / 2.7) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 1.589e8 * v ^ 97 := by rw [mul_div_assoc']; rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
  have rhs : 0.0114 * v ^ 128 / (4.0804 * 49) ≤ (1.049 - 1.0376) * (v ^ 128 / c ^ 2) / κ := by
    rw [κ]
    have : v ^ 128 / 4.0804 ≤ v ^ 128 / c ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hc2' hc2
    calc 0.0114 * v ^ 128 / (4.0804 * 49) = (1.049 - 1.0376) * (v ^ 128 / 4.0804) / 49 := by
          ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have key : 1.589e8 * v ^ 97 < 0.0114 * v ^ 128 / (4.0804 * 49) := by
    have h97 : 0 < v ^ 97 := by positivity
    have h31 : (2.64 : ℝ) ^ 31 ≤ v ^ 31 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hvbig 31
    rw [show v ^ 128 = v ^ 31 * v ^ 97 by ring, lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h31 h97.le]
  linarith

snippet.text:
/-- **Non-prime and even terms**, a weaker form of [H, (14.51)]: the terms where some `nᵢ` is
even or not prime contribute at most `6.7 · 10⁶ · N^{3/2} log N`.

[H] gets the constant `7.3306` from the sharp sup norms `|η₊|_∞ ≤ 1.079955`,
`|η_*|_∞ ≤ 1.414` and the Rosser–Schoenfeld bounds `ψ(x) < 1.03883 x`,
`ψ(x) - θ(x) < 1.4262 √x`.  We use the easy bounds `|η₊| ≤ 400`, `|η_*| ≤ 6.2`
(`Helfgott/SupNorms.lean`) and the elementary `ψ(N) ≤ 1.387 N`, `ψ(N) - θ(N) ≤ 1.6 √N`
(`Helfgott/Chebyshev.lean`) instead; the final inequality still has room
(`final_inequality_crude`).

*Proved.* -/
theorem nonprime_input (N : ℕ) (hN27 : 10 ^ 27 ≤ N) :
    repSum (fun _ => True) N - repSum (fun n => n.Prime ∧ Odd n) N ≤
      6.7e6 * (N * √N) * Real.log N := by
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := le_trans (by norm_num) hN27
  have h := repSum_sub_le_of_bounds hN (fun t ht => abs_etaPlus_le_400 ht)
    (fun t _ => abs_etaStar_le_const t)
  have hpsi := psi_le N hN27
  have hpt := psi_sub_theta_le N hN27
  have hNr : (10 : ℝ) ^ 27 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN27
  have hsq : (10 : ℝ) ^ 13 ≤ √N := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith)
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 0.0001 * √N := by
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; nlinarith
  have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log N := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hN)
  have hbad0 : 0 ≤ psi N - theta N + Real.log 2 :=
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => ΛBad_nonneg n).trans (sum_ΛBad_le N)
  have hpsi0 : 0 ≤ psi N := Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => vonMangoldt_nonneg
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ √(N : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  calc repSum (fun _ => True) N - repSum (fun n => n.Prime ∧ Odd n) N
      ≤ 3 * (400 ^ 2 * 6.2) * Real.log N * (psi N - theta N + Real.log 2) * psi N := h
    _ ≤ 3 * (400 ^ 2 * 6.2) * Real.log N * (1.6001 * √N) * (1.387 * N) := by
        gcongr; linarith
    _ = (3 * (400 ^ 2 * 6.2) * 1.6001 * 1.387) * (N * √N) * Real.log N := by ring
    _ ≤ 6.7e6 * (N * √N) * Real.log N := by gcongr; norm_num

proof_context.conclusion: For odd $N\ge10^{27}$, $(1.049-1.0376)x^2/\kappa\le$ `repSum (fun _ => True) N`: splits the circle integral into $\mathfrak M_{8,r_0}$ and its complement, bounds the first below and the norm of the second above, and takes real parts.

snippet.text:
/-- Steps 1–2: the full weighted count is at least `(1.049 - 1.0376) x²/κ`. -/
theorem repSum_lower_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : Odd N) (hN27 : 10 ^ 27 ≤ N) :
    (1.049 - 1.0376) * xOf N ^ 2 / κ ≤ repSum (fun _ => True) N := by
  set M := majorArcs 8 r₀ (xOf N)
  obtain ⟨hint, hid⟩ := circle_identity_input N (by omega)
  have hsplit := integral_inter_add_sdiff (measurableSet_majorArcs 8 r₀ (xOf N)) hint
  have hmaj := major_arcs_input N hN hN27
  have hmin := minor_arcs_input N hN27
  -- The minor arc contribution is bounded by the integral of the norm.
  have hnorm : ‖∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 \ M, integrand N α‖ ≤ 1.0376 * xOf N ^ 2 / κ := by
    refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hmin)
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_Ioc.diff (measurableSet_majorArcs _ _ _)) ?_
    intro α _
    simp only [integrand, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_e, mul_one]
    ring
  have hre : repSum (fun _ => True) N =
      (∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ M, integrand N α).re +
        (∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 \ M, integrand N α).re := by
    rw [← Complex.add_re, hsplit, hid, ofReal_re]
  have := neg_le_of_abs_le ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans hnorm)
  rw [hre]
  simp only [κ, M] at hmaj this ⊢
  linarith

annotation.note: Lean gets $\ge(1.049-1.0376)x^2/\kappa-6.7\cdot10^6N^{3/2}\log N>0$ (constants $0.0114$ and $6.7\cdot10^6$ for $0.08433$ and $7.3306$); `final_inequality` proves the $7.3306$ comparison, but no $0.000422N^2$ bound is stated, only positivity.

proof_context.conclusion: Combines `repSum_lower_bound`, `nonprime_input`, `final_inequality_crude`: the sum over odd primes is positive, so every odd $N\ge10^{27}$ is a sum of three primes.

snippet.text:
/-- **Helfgott's theorem for large `N`**: every odd `N ≥ 10²⁷` is a sum of three primes
(in fact of three odd primes). -/
theorem ternaryGoldbachFrom : TernaryGoldbachFrom (10 ^ 27) := by
  intro N hN hN27
  have h1 := repSum_lower_bound N hN hN27
  have h2 := nonprime_input N hN27
  have h3 := final_inequality_crude N hN27
  apply isSumOfThreePrimes_of_repSum_ne_zero (P := fun n => n.Prime ∧ Odd n) (fun n h => h.1)
  intro h0
  linarith
